name: Ouka
source:
Ouka works as a fortune teller by day and boasts incredible amounts of mature, womanly charm; all facts that stay relatively ironic considering she has absolutely no experience with love or romance whatsoever. Most of her costumers are women interested in love related advice. She takes interest in the protagonist for his aura, which she claims has a very unique and interesting shape.

[spoiler]Her real name is Izumi Sakura (泉 咲桜).[/spoiler]
